changelog: Brand-new controller interface: sharp radar with non-overlapping labels, compact flight strips, heading dial and clearer orders.
Redesigned admin panel with a better airport map editor, on-demand crisis trigger, Advanced tuning tab and full French translation.
Fixed the post getting locked for everyone, the player sinking into the floor, the target vanishing after an acn_bridge restart and the cursor on the session report.
First release: virtual air traffic controller job with a modern radar, flight strips and a full set of aircraft orders.
Random and scripted crises, 5 editable grades with XP and pay, and a session report.
/conf_acn_airtraffic configures everything live in game, including raycast placement of the tower post and a visual airport map editor.
